title: Realize the QQ16 L2 record with paid native frames
head: 9cc0d4d60819ddd246c9db9549f8ae4a61b68e45
body:
PR2470's L2 logical reconstruction combines live post-B1 X/Y with a retained F0 T record, whose native frames differ. This adds an explicit paid native word that reconstructs all 96 old-cut ordinary arrays, restores all 200 source arrays, and rejects a tempting current-chart alignment that mishandles the already accumulated E1 frame.

The local invoice is **400 rank-one children + 96 rank-eight children** (rank mass **1,168**), **208 full-cover maps**, **992 native wrapper maps**, and **6,624 real scalar primitives** under the pinned QQ16 cost function. Its contract explicitly requires **96 owned output arrays and one local owned scratch array**. It supplies neither the complete 224-input decoder nor a net storage/supplier improvement.

The package contains an ordered arbitrary-array proof, a complete 1,426-event word, source and predecessor Git/SHA256 pins, exact owner-route and 73-bit phase checks, 106,496 rank-one basis columns, 65,536 rank-eight kernel coefficients, nine semantic controls and five export/boundary tests. The sources, proof and limits are in `research/qq16-l2-native-reconstruction/`.

Validation: native CPython **3.12.7** registered replay passes, including optimized boundary/export tests; **3.14.5** optimized primary replay passes. A separate agent review found no material issue after correcting two unused map-name labels. It independently checked 281,008 character evaluations across all 104 ports, exact restoration/ownership and the complete invoice; the mathematical receipt and literal word were unchanged by the label fix. The registered command is:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-l2-native-reconstruction
```

Expected markers: `PASS_QQ16_L2_NATIVE_RECONSTRUCTION` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. The default replay is read-only and works without Git in a source export. Source drift and changes to the complete word or receipt are rejected. No selected supplier cold replay, hosted CI, proof assistant or independent human review is claimed.

Base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Predecessors: PR2470 `1b2eee3bf1ec67e68c0b0fa7f47c7b2a66febe56`, PR2468 `baa90ee8176931e697d91a9024114ee2e9a189ea`, and the retained PR1969 packet/native contract. Credit thakrarsagar for L2, starship-s for the original cut decoder, Ali Romman for QQ16, and the retained native/geometry lineage. Native support methods are explicitly adapted from this account's PR2468. Final live overlap covered 679 open PRs at 12:25:32 UTC and 1,197 discussion records at 12:29:05 UTC with complete pagination/no warnings; main and both source heads remained unchanged. The advance claim is [here](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2470#issuecomment-6191762591).

Ross Richardson's active discussion 2424 work minimizes the retained record with native reads granted; this contribution neither minimizes that record nor claims its decoder. Physical map implementation, record delivery/retirement, new-child hosting, precision, global controller and complete supplier costs remain open. No new kappa claim. Open next questions name the paid-output consumption, lower-cost frame choice and global admission obligations.

Prepared by **ywz65** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, source review, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; predecessor source notices retained.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
